Description
: Add timeless appeal to your collection with this unique tobacciana lot, featuring an array of distinctive items. Included are two vintage cigar boxesVegaFina and Boston Store Kingseach with classic wood construction and vibrant vintage detailing. The lot also presents a rare long clay pipe in its original Zenith box, ideal for display or light use by pipe enthusiasts.
Collectors will appreciate the Buckingham Bright Cut Plug Tobacco tin, two Marlboro-branded items (cases or boxes), a deep ruby red pressed glass ashtray with ornate floral geometric design, two classic flip-top lighters, a lighter shaped like a gold ingot, and a charming red toy car lighter for novelty appeal. These pieces reflect mid-century style and classic tobacco advertising.
All items are pre-owned with moderate visible wear such as minor scuffs or patina, consistent with age and use. This versatile assortment is perfect for vintage display, creative decor, or as an impressive starter kit for new collectors.

Large mixed lot of polished and raw crystals and mineral specimens in many colors and sizes. Notable pieces include a purple quartz tower point, a golden brown tiger eye style tower point, a pink rose quartz palm stone and a carved stone skull. Also included are many tumbled stones, rough chunks and small crystal fragments, a few wire wrapped pendant pieces and a small amber glass roller bottle with a silver tone cap. Stones are not individually identified.

Condition: Pre-owned. Some rough pieces show chips and surface wear, loose dust and tiny fragments are present, and the metal pendant pieces are tarnished.
